entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand GPS tracker I bought. It's useless and I want my money back. Now.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with the product. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't want it. I've had it for about a month and it's just been sitting here. Don't you dare tell me it's too late to send it back.
I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just pull up your account to check the purchase details. Can I get your order number or the email address you used?
It's david.peters@email.com. And I swear, if you start quoting some nonsense policy about hygiene or sanitation for a wristband, I'm going to lose it. I want to speak to your manager.
I understand you want to get this resolved quickly. Let me just check the timeline for you first... Okay, Mr. Peters, I see your VeloBand was delivered 36 days ago.
That's right, 36 days! So what are you going to do? I'm one click away from posting a review about this experience on every website I can find.

There's no need for that, sir. Our VeloFit policy actually allows for returns up to 10 days from the date of delivery. You're unfortunately outside that window, so I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Wait... seriously? You're just... approving it?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Well, okay then. I was expecting a huge fight. Thank you.
You're very welcome. We want to make things as simple as possible. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
